routes.label: Separate full weeks from extra days

question: The War of \(1812\) started with a declaration of war on Thursday, June \(18,\) \(1812.\) The peace treaty to end the war was signed \(919\) days later, on December \(24,\) \(1814.\) On what day of the week was the treaty signed?
solution:
Every full week returns us to the same day of the week, so divide the elapsed time into groups of seven days:
\[
919=7\cdot131+2.
\]
After \(131\) full weeks, the day is still Thursday. The two additional days take us to Friday and then Saturday. The treaty was signed on Saturday, choice B.
